By the end of today

grid

A gallery of rows and columns.

auto-fit

As many columns as fit the screen.

span 2

One tile takes two columns.

caption

The name and genre under each picture.

The idea

The grid counts the columns

source · style.css
style.css
1.gallery {
2 display: grid;
3 gap: 24px;
4 grid-template-columns:
5 repeat(auto-fit,
6 minmax(240px, 1fr));
7}
→ auto-fit: as many as fit
→ minmax: never under 240px
→ 1fr: share what is left
